discovery_notes: Follow-up to 249_b083 (reuses its keys). 30 standard searches, snippets only (BoxLunch, MyPinCentral, DPB, Loungefly UK, Disney Mouseketeer, mall-hosted BoxLunch listing). Holds released only where a per-pin fan DB entry names the design: Cupcake Cheshire/Dumbo/Simba, Bubbles Dumbo. Valentine's couples 2-pin hold resolved by DPB lineup. Added Compact Mirror Cinderella/Mulan/Belle, Poster Jawa, Cupcake Dalmatians, Inside Out Sadness/Anger/Fear singles, D23 Saturday 3 LE pins, 6 couples sets, 4 Dec 2024 blind boxes. Classic VHS WDPN3534 kept as held lead.
